issues.reason: "reached the Hollows" is a bare direct object and Thematic roles reserve Goal for a spatial "to"-oblique ("the direct-object roles are for objects the verb takes without a preposition"), with the instruction set's own worked example encoding "Sara reached the platform" as (Theme sk_reach_1 sk_platform_1).

Quantifiers, generics & scope states that the same rule form distributes a distributive predicate over "a grouped / counted plural" ("the dogs barked"), and Cardinality says such a plural keeps the group event and ADDS the per-member rule, so burn, show, survive, flee, reach and leave each owe an (Implication (PartOf $x <group>) (And ...)) rule that only the sky-cat events received.

The half that stands: "The mist-light" is a specific definite, which Existential encodes as a typed sk_ individual and says to "never" fill with a bare class symbol; the half that is overstated: the kind/individual dual role is not itself ill-typed, since (Inheritance mist_light light) is mandatory compound decomposition and the earlier bare-mass fillers in "produced / showed mist-light" are the licensed non-specific kind filler.

Threads deposited on a lantern are not created, destroyed, consumed or physically changed by the leaving, so the stated "does the object itself change?" test - and its explicit "when the test is unclear, default to Theme" fallback - gives Theme, not Patient.

gaps_confirmed: Day-of-year ordinal date ("day 300 of Year 1"): the Time terms define (Day n) only as a day-of-month composing with Month/Year, so a day counted within a year has no licensed granularity term.

Mass-noun anaphora: nothing links a bare-kind mass mention ("produced mist-light") to a later definite re-mention ("The mist-light"), which the definite rule would make a fresh witness with no connection back to the kind filler.
new_gaps: Agent-nominalization taking an of-phrase that names its underlying object ("the keepers of the Harbor Row"): Complements of nouns and adjectives scopes the (Of ...) oblique to act/result/quality nominalizations and the Possession genitive to relational nouns "where no underlying verb exists", so an agent noun that does have a live underlying verb falls between the two rules and nothing decides the head.

Collective "together" on a group-witness subject ("the keepers ... together lit", "Together, the lanterns produced") has no positive carrier: with a single group symbol the licensed "one event with multiple Agent atoms" shape collapses to one Agent atom, so the collective reading is recorded only by the ABSENCE of the per-member distribution rule - indistinguishable from a parse that simply omitted it.
defect_summary: "reached the Hollows" should be (Theme sk_reach_1 hollows), the same direct-object role the instruction set's "Sara reached the platform" example uses. Each distributive group event - burn, show, survive, flee, reach, leave - should carry a per-member (Implication (PartOf $x <group>) (And ...)) rule at (STV 1.0 0.9) beside the group event, exactly as the sky-cat descend/hunt/molt events do. The definite "The mist-light" should fill the Agent slot with a fresh typed individual, (Member sk_mist_light_1 mist_light), the bare kind symbol staying only in the earlier non-specific "produced / showed mist-light" mentions. "left silken threads" should be (Theme sk_leave_1 sk_thread_1).
notes: The participle in "the surviving nightmoths" is recorded by no atom, though Core patterns bars silently dropping a stated modifier and the descriptive-modifier rule gives it a licensed form (distribution over sk_survivors_1's members). Name handling, group/Cardinality shape, compound decomposition and the During link are otherwise clean.
